description: Implementation of functions for the parent class of Cells in a battery simulation, including diffusion, thermal, and degradation state updates, as well as time stepping methods.

classes.name: Cell_SPM
classes.description: Parent class for battery cell models implementing diffusion, thermal, and degradation dynamics.

methods.name: dState_diffusion
methods.description: Calculates the diffusion PDE for lithium concentration states and updates the state of charge.

methods.name: dState_thermal
methods.description: Calculates the internal heat generation based on current states and updates the heat generation variable.

methods.name: dState_degradation
methods.description: Calculates the effects of degradation mechanisms such as SEI growth, crack growth, lithium plating, and updates related states.

methods.name: timeStep_CC
methods.description: Performs multiple diffusion and thermal/degradation time steps with constant current over a specified period.
